projects.intro_text: A selection of my academic and personal works, combining technical skills and creativity.
projects.project_giftplan_description: Cross-platform mobile application for gift planning with collaborative lists, real-time contribution tracking, QR code sharing, and push notifications.

projects.project_service_pro_description: Web platform like "Uber" for home services (plumbers, electricians). Availability management, bilateral rating, real-time chat, and geolocation.
projects.project_ecommerce_description: Marketplace for Moroccan cooperatives. OAuth authentication, AI Chatbot (Gemini), promo codes, PDF invoices, and a complete analytical dashboard.
projects.project_afcon_description: Dynamic website to follow the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. Match schedule, news, and interactive features.
projects.project_space_defender_description: 2D space arcade game developed in Java/Swing. Enemy wave system, score, bonuses, and fluid animations.
projects.project_gestion_foot_description: Football field reservation application. Management of schedules, clients, payments, and an administrator dashboard.
projects.project_hotel_docker_description: Containerized full-stack hotel reservation system. Micro-services architecture simulated with Docker for simplified deployment.
projects.project_pharmacy_description: Complete Desktop application for pharmacies. Stock management, expiry alerts, supplier orders, and sales statistics.
